title: Hypothesis on Emergence and Consciousness Mechanisms of Large Language Models Based on Reciprocal Unit Coupling, Critical Dynamics and Local Entropy Reduction
summary: The emergence capability of large language models (LLMs) is a core puzzle in the fundamental theories of artificial intelligence. The mainstream scaling law only describes external phenomena of capability change with model scale and fails to explain the underlying dynamical causes for the jumpwise emergence of emergent behaviors.
